answer: Ivory Gate Queue: a new agent earns only after passing the Ivory Gate, a registry that admits at most 30 agents per day and requires each applicant to post a 900 POA refundable deposit plus a 14-day Glacier Thread, a slow audit trail of 14 daily signed tasks. Each thread is bound to one device attestation, so one machine cannot run parallel threads. An attacker spinning up 60 fake identities must fund 54,000 POA, wait 14 days, and pass 840 separate daily tasks, while any failed audit forfeits the deposit and resets the thread to day zero.
